title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this chapter, unless the context requires otherwise:

"Department" means the department of health.

"Hydrolysis equipment" has the same meaning as in section 531B-2.

"Hydrolysis facility" has the same meaning as in section 531B-2.
bodyHtml:
[§327N-1]  Definitions.  As used in this chapter, unless the context requires otherwise:

     "Department" means the department of health.

     "Hydrolysis equipment" has the same meaning as in section 531B-2.

     "Hydrolysis facility" has the same meaning as in section 531B-2. [L 2022, c 294, pt of §2]
